// REQ: LANG-2801 LANG-2802 LANG-2803 LANG-2804
/* Greeter component */
component accessors="true" {
    property name="name" type="string" default="world";
    public string function greet(numeric times = 1) {
        var text = "Hello, #name#! ""hi""";
        for (var i = 1; i <= times; i++) { writeOutput(text); }
        return text;
    }
}
